title: GLava Master Panel
tooltip_avg_frames: Averaging an image across multiple frames. This prevents flicker but adds a slight delay.
tooltip_bar_count: Number of posts on the circumference.
tooltip_bar_gap: The spacing between the bars. 0 means the bars will touch.
tooltip_bar_sharp: Sharpness of the edges of the posts.
tooltip_bar_width: The width of a single bar in pixels.
tooltip_bass_cutoff: Cutting off the lowest noise and bass so that the bars don't jump at the lowest sound.
tooltip_border: Thickness of the frame of each post.
tooltip_bufsize:
FFT buffer size — power of 2
Larger = more 'gravity'
512=fast, 4096=heavy
tooltip_center_line: The thickness of the line inside the column.
tooltip_circle_line: The thickness of the line drawing the center circle.
tooltip_circle_sharp: Edge smoothing. Eliminates the effect of jagged edges.
tooltip_disable_mono: Forces stereo mode, even when mirrored.
tooltip_draw_border: Draws an outline along the edge of the graph.
tooltip_edge_smooth: Smoothing edges, requires opacity: xroot or none.
tooltip_expert: Unlock advanced audio and rendering options.
tooltip_fft_scale: Frequency range scale on the graph.
tooltip_fps_limit: Maximum frames per second, never more than your monitor's refresh rate.
tooltip_gain: Bar Height Multiplier - increases sound sensitivity.
tooltip_gradient: The function lightens the current gradient.
tooltip_gravity: The speed at which the bars fall. Higher values ​​indicate heavier, faster falling bars.
tooltip_interpolate:
Smooths animation between audio frames
Improves fluidity but adds minimal latency.
tooltip_invert_spectrum: It switches sides. The bass ends up on the sides and the treble ends up in the center of the screen.
tooltip_inward: When enabled, high frequencies are in the center and low frequencies are on the sides of the graph.
tooltip_join_center: Combines channels in the center of the screen.
tooltip_line_thickness: The thickness of the line that forms the outline of the visualization.
tooltip_line_width: The thickness of the line that forms the outline of the visualization.
tooltip_mirror:
Averages left and right channels
Does not work with INVERT enabled
tooltip_offset_x: X offset, +/- half the X dimension of the screen.
tooltip_offset_y: Y offset, +/- half the Y dimension of the screen.
tooltip_radial_fill: Fills the inner circle of the visualization with a gradient.
tooltip_samplerate:
Audio sample rate
22050 Hz = standard
44100 Hz = high quality
tooltip_smooth_factor: Frequency smoothing. Lower values ​​result in faster response, higher values ​​result in smoother movement.
tooltip_smooth_post:
Post-processing image smoothing.
Only works with opacity: x root
tooltip_swap_lr: Swaps the left and right channel signals.
tooltip_vertical_bar: Rotates the visualization 90 degrees (Bars grow from the side of the screen)
tooltip_rotate_wave:
Wave rotation. -180 = clockwise, +180 = counter-clockwise.
Shift+drag = fine control
tooltip_offset_x_wave:
Wave center X offset. Default ±half screen width.
Shift+drag = fine control
tooltip_offset_y_wave:
Wave center Y offset. Default ±half screen height.
Shift+drag = fine control
tooltip_wave_length:
Wave length in pixels. 0 = full screen width.
Shift+drag = fine control
tooltip_unlock_range: Unlocks range up to 110% of screen diagonal for wave length and offsets
tooltip_rotate:
Wave rotation. -180 = clockwise, +180 = counter-clockwise.
Shift+drag = fine control
tooltip_offset_x:
Wave center offset on X axis. Default ±half screen width.
Shift+drag = fine control
tooltip_offset_y:
Wave center offset on Y axis. Default ±half screen height.
Shift+drag = fine control
